exposure: Transcutaneous bilirubin (TcB) measurements from BiliCare device
Transcutaneous bilirubin (TcB) measurements from MBJ20 device
outcome: Accuracy and agreement of TcB devices with STB
Predictive accuracy for the need for phototherapy
cohort: Eighty-eight jaundiced infants born at or after 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: Both BiliCare and MBJ20 transcutaneous bilirubin devices demonstrated a strong correlation with serum total bilirubin, with BiliCare showing superior predictive accuracy for identifying the need for phototherapy.
